description: This source file contains a NUnit test class 'SampleLoginNavigationTest' that tests navigation to the login page of a web application using Selenium WebDriver in a C# project. The test verifies that it can navigate to the login page without launching an actual browser when in discovery-only mode.

classes.name: SampleLoginNavigationTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies navigation to the login page in a Selenium-based UI test setup.

methods.name: CanNavigateToLoginPage
methods.description: A test method that attempts to open the login page and asserts successful navigation, considering discovery-only mode.

calls: Assert.That(Driver, Is.Null, "Driver must not be created in discovery-only mode.")
Assert.Pass("Discovery-only mode: test executed without launching a browser.")
